# LitCharts

> > LitCharts is a comprehensive digital literature platform offering study guides, AI-powered educational tools, and modern Shakespeare translations for students and educators.

LitCharts provides interactive literary analysis resources including detailed guides for novels and poetry, AI-assisted learning tools for discussion and essay writing, and Shakescleare's modern English translations of Shakespeare's works. The platform combines traditional study materials with contemporary AI technology to support student learning and teacher instruction.

## Key Topics

- Literary Analysis
- Literature Guides
- Shakespeare Translations
- Poetry Analysis
- Study Tools

## Core Platform

- [LitCharts Homepage](https://www.litcharts.com): Main entry point to LitCharts literature guides, study tools, and educational platform
- [Literature Guides](https://www.litcharts.com/lit): Comprehensive literature guides hub with summaries, analysis, and study resources
- [Poetry Guides](https://www.litcharts.com/poetry): Poetry guides with line-by-line analysis and poetic device explanations

## AI-Powered Tools

- [Ask LitCharts AI](https://www.litcharts.com/ai/ask-litcharts-ai): Interactive AI assistant for literary analysis and answering questions about texts
- [Discussion Question Generator](https://www.litcharts.com/ai/discussion-question-generator): AI-powered tool for generating discussion questions for literature study and classroom use
- [Essay Prompt Generator](https://www.litcharts.com/ai/essay-prompt-generator): AI writing tool for generating essay prompts and student writing assistance
- [Quiz Question Generator](https://www.litcharts.com/ai/quiz-question-generator): AI tool for generating quiz questions and educational assessments

## Shakespeare Resources

- [Shakescleare: Modern English Shakespeare Translations](https://www.litcharts.com/shakescleare/shakespeare-translations): Side-by-side modern English translations of Shakespeare works for easier comprehension

## User Accounts & Subscriptions

- [Sign In](https://www.litcharts.com/sign-in): User account authentication with sign-in, password reset, and account management
- [Sign Up for LitCharts A+](https://www.litcharts.com/sign-up): Premium subscription signup offering PDF downloads, teacher editions, and exclusive features

## Support & Help

- [LitCharts Help Center](https://help.litcharts.com): FAQ and support resources for subscriptions, accounts, and general user assistance
